evidencePack.title: GenLayer Scout - local-first builder evidence workspace
evidencePack.projectSummary: GenLayer Scout is a local-first dashboard for tracking Studio contract experiments, contribution lanes, build notes, and evidence packs for Portal submissions. It is designed to keep manual evidence organized without claiming live GenLayer API access.
evidencePack.genLayerRelevance: GenLayer builders need a practical way to preserve contract file names, observed deployment states, evidence links, limitations, and next milestones between Studio work and Portal submission writing. Scout focuses on that handoff.
